classification.difficultyReason: Combine four supplied imperial conversion factors, then convert centimetres to kilometres.

content.prompt: In bygone days, the imperial system of measurement was used. In this system, distance is measured in inches, feet, yards and miles. There are 12 inches in a foot, 3 feet in a yard and 1760 yards in a mile. Given that 2.54 cm equals 1 inch, how many kilometres is a mile?

answer.worked: $$\begin{align*}1\text{ mile}&=1760\text{ yards}\\1\text{ mile}&=1760\times3\text{ feet}\\1\text{ mile}&=5280\times12\text{ inches}\\1\text{ mile}&=63360\times2.54\text{ cm}\\1\text{ mile}&=160934.4\text{ cm}\\1\text{ mile}&=\frac{160934.4}{100\times1000}\text{ km}\\1\text{ mile}&=1.609344\text{ km}\end{align*}$$
